summary.intent: Evaluate whether tsrs (an Oxc-project Rust port of the TypeScript checker) could replace or supplement caliper's tsc backend, and whether tsrs crates might be published so caliper could link it as a library.
summary.outcome: Established that tsrs works as a second binary for caliper's opt-in semantic backend (87 of 87 oracle fixtures matched) but found no sign crates.io publishing is planned. Recommended a tag-pinned git dependency spike and a process-mode fallback, and left the spike and a public comment on issue #858 awaiting user approval. PR #384's pipe-in-literal fix was also pushed and its body updated.

repo: tsrs workspace sets publish = false on every crate; it ships only as npm packages (tsrs, @tsrs/<platform>, @tsrs/wasm), and the repo has release tags v0.15.0..v0.23.0 roughly every 2-3 days.
tsrs ports microsoft/TypeScript commit 3e9236361fa9, the gitHead of typescript@7.1.0-beta, the same pin caliper's tsgo build uses; a new TS version means a new port.

tsrs docs/NODE_API.md documents an in-process Rust contract: tsrs_api::Session::new(SessionOptions{cwd, default_library_path, fs,...}) -> Arc<Session>, implementing Handler::handle_request(method, params) with the same method names caliper sends over RPC.
tsrs needs Rust 1.99 / edition 2024 (caliper pins 1.97), about 45 crates, its own mimalloc setup, and has its own parser, so caliper's oxc parse would still run alongside it.

tsrs_pseudochecker ports typescript-go internal/pseudochecker, types only trivial initializer expressions and never interprets annotations. It is relevant only to the as-const/literal rules in caliper's resolver/evaluate.rs, not to the tuple, accessor, call-signature, & {} or alias-forwarding defects.

Checker output is identical across typescript-beta, tsrs and tsc 6.0.3: 'a'|'b'|string prints string, while 'a'|'b'|(string & {}) prints "a" | (string & {}). Caliper collapses the latter to 'a' | string (matrix row A13), added to Batch 2 in trail #255.

tsrs's docs/COMPATIBILITY.md lists no mapped, conditional, indexed-access, template or intersection gaps; its bench shows ~2-3x faster and ~2.1-2.6x less memory than tsgo on 19 projects, but Chakra and Mantine are not included.

Issues #858 (publish to crates.io) and #871 (long-term vision) have only triage-bot replies and no maintainer response. PRs are closed, and the Cloudflare announcement names npm only as the distribution channel.

code.finding: Calls 19 RPC methods, all present in tsrs's method list; none of tsrs's 4 unsupported methods are among them.
Version allow-list for the spawned binary; 0.23.0-ts7.1.0-beta would need adding to use tsrs. Version check on the adjacent package.json is at lines 100-101.
Union handling turns 'a'|'b'|(string & {}) into 'a' | string, losing the & {} shape (matrix row A13).

workflow: Peer-session idle notifications can repeat earlier findings; check what is new before acting.
Public comments on external issues (e.g. tsrs #858) are outward-facing, so the assistant asked for the user's approval first.

Spikes were scoped to avoid the oracle and corpora, keeping process mode as a fallback until numbers (compile time, binary size, resident memory after close, time to first answer vs semanticWaitMs=150) exist.

friction: The teammate's report was truncated, so the full text had to be read from /tmp/claude-501/ast/FINAL.txt.
The teammate's raw async JSON-RPC probe was blocked by the sandbox classifier, so framing was only verified through the sync SDK.
Maintainers are unresponsive on crates.io and roadmap questions (bot replies only), so intent can't be confirmed.
CI on PR #384 had Coverage and Entire Gates still pending when last checked.
open_items: Decide whether to run the tsrs spike: a scratch branch with a git dependency at tag v0.23.0, building tsrs_api alone and measuring compile time, binary size, memory after close and time to first answer.

Cheaper experiment awaiting approval: run --experimental-semantic-types with tsc_path pointed at the tsrs binary on the same fixtures and diff caliper's JSON, then time first answer on a Chakra-sized project.
Decide whether to post a question on tsrs issue #858 under the user's account.
Verify that tsrs's async JSON-RPC framing works with caliper's own client.
Check whether a long-running dev process frees memory when a tsrs Session closes (the arena uses &'static sources and a poison mode).
Making any checker the default would need oracle evidence and a new ADR; the TS 7.1 backend stays experimental and off by default.
Fix matrix row A13 (& {} union shape) in Batch 2 of trail #255 after #379 merges, alongside tuple optional/rest elements, getter-as-function members and mapped-type as/readonly modifiers.
Pending user decisions: #379, #380, #384, #385 (after #379) and #291; the #379 findings worker is still running.
